## Inline Code Comments
- tests/container-images/verify_release_config.sh:209: `grep -qw` matches word boundaries but treats the package name as a regex pattern, where `.` is a metacharacter matching any character. For package names like `libapache2-mod-wsgi-py3`, this means a package like `libapache2Xmod-wsgi-py3` would also match (false positive). Using `-F` (fixed-string mode) would be more robust:

```suggestion
    if grep -v '^ARG ' "$dockerfile" | grep -v '^#' | grep 'apt-get install' -A 20 \
        | grep -qFw "$pkg"; then
```
